headline: Pinnacle West Capital Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Pinnacle West Capital (NYSE:PNW) reported second-quarter 2026 earnings of $1.43 per share, down $0.15 from the same period a year earlier, as higher interest expense, depreciation and amortization, and lower transmission revenue more than offset strong weather-driven demand and customer growth.
